disclaimer: Illustrative demonstration rules and thresholds for SYNTHETIC data only. They have not been validated for any real-world operational, customs, security or financial decision and must not be used as such. A high score indicates data-quality or relationship inconsistencies in fictional records; it is not evidence of wrongdoing by any person or organisation.

rules.title: Required field missing
rules.description: A field that is mandatory for this record type is absent or empty.

rules.title: Duplicate document reference
rules.description: The record's document reference (manifest number, air waybill, invoice number or transaction reference) also appears on another record of the same type.

rules.title: Conflicting amounts across linked documents
rules.description: An invoice amount differs from its shipment's declared value, or a transaction amount differs from its invoice, by more than the configured tolerance.

rules.title: Currency differs from linked document
rules.description: The currency on this record differs from the currency on the document it is linked to.

rules.title: Invalid date ordering
rules.description: Timestamps are in an impossible or inconsistent order (arrival not after departure, or payment dated long before the invoice).

rules.title: Counterparty differs from linked document
rules.description: The parties named on this record do not match the parties on the linked shipment or invoice.

rules.title: Reference reused across unrelated records
rules.description: A linked document ID is claimed by more than one record that should each have their own document.

rules.title: Broken or non-reciprocal link
rules.description: A linked record does not exist in the dataset, or it does not link back to this record.

rules.title: Repeated entity reference
rules.description: The consignee on this shipment appears on an unusually high number of shipments in the dataset.

rules.title: Invalid field value
rules.description: A value is malformed or outside its allowed range (non-positive quantity or amount, unknown currency or airport code, malformed timestamp, origin equals destination).

rules.title: Multiple independent findings
rules.description: Several different rules fired on the same record, which raises its review priority.

balanced.label: Balanced (default)
balanced.description: Default demo profile. Flags MEDIUM and above (score >= 30).

strict.label: Strict
strict.description: Tighter tolerances and a lower flag threshold. Catches more planted patterns but produces more false positives.

lenient.label: Lenient
lenient.description: Wider tolerances and a higher flag threshold (score >= 35). Fewer false positives, lower recall: single date, counterparty, link or format findings are not flagged on their own.
